source.notes: Observed key-specific runtime consumer stack supports this Settings use. Import-path association is explicitly inferred by component name. Original native TypeScript source text and exhaustive application-wide uses are not claimed. The Android gesture handle changes from light to dark because its platform rendering adapts to the brighter underlying surface. AOSP RegionSamplingHelper samples screen luminance and uses threshold 0.5 for navigation contrast; NavigationHandle.setDarkIntensity blends its light/dark colours. This explains the observed dependent platform effect; no second colour-key override occurred. Full screenshots retain the handle.
